name: careeros-patterns
description: Self-contained recipes taken from CareerOS, a creator's studio app built with Claude. Each recipe has a demo, framework-free code and ADAPT.md instructions for an AI.

recipes.title: YouTube homepage preview
recipes.summary: Shows a thumbnail as a YouTube-style home-feed card, and in a full home-feed preview among other videos, so a creator can judge how it stands out.
needs_from_host: one to three candidate thumbnail image URLs
the video title and channel name
optional list of other videos: image, title, channel, views, published date

pathways.title: Video editing pathway
pathways.summary: The whole route from a finished script to an exported talking-head video in Premiere Pro: animation deck, transcription, acoustic clean cut, flub cuts, cutting the sequence in place through UXP, rendering animations with alpha and placing them on the timeline.
pathways.note: Copied as it runs on one PC. Paths, brand and settings are the author's own. Read it to learn how it works and rebuild it for your setup.
needs: Adobe Premiere Pro 25.6 with a UXP panel

skills.title: Video editing prep
skills.summary: A Claude skill that turns a finished script into an HTML animation deck and a two-column script and shot list.
